purpose: Native Vipi identity and first-run design review

mobbin.observed: Single strong benefit headline, brand color field, anchored primary action; visual image overlaps. Adopt hierarchy, not layout or imagery.
One language choice action on a compact card over a human image. Transfer clear next step; do not borrow teaching promise.
One immediate activity and anchored CTA. Vipi instead demonstrates its real inline flip interaction.
Visible progress and grouped outcomes. Vipi retains two-step progress, rejects course/fluency/streak framing.

bfm.evidence: Full hydrated article read through exact lookup. Apply interactive real demo before account, simple first task, defer secondary features.
rejected_advisory_suggestions: location permission: local means on-device, not geography
microphone permission/pronunciation practice: not an implemented Vipi feature
new interests/topic preferences: no supporting product capability
commitment pledges/streaks: inconsistent with ambient exposure

primary_guidelines.retrieval: Official Markdown retrieved by curl after browser tool rejected Markdown MIME. Large simple shapes, full bleed opaque background, vector source and system masking.
Official current document read. Foreground/background/monochrome layers; 108 canvas with 66 center safe region.

decisions: Preserve warm paper / forest theme and editorial headings; make dark primary controls adapt semantically.
Replace platform-dependent bubble/font icon with exact shared original geometry.
Shorten eyebrow to fit typical phone width.
Offer Original versus Immersion demonstration, not full-sentence translation.
Retain one CTA and an interactive example before account creation.
No new navigation destinations without actual product capability. Existing Chats, new conversation, profile/settings structure is appropriate for current scope.
limits: No claim of world-class acceptance or user research.
New simulator visual checks pending root integration.
No signed build, keychain, iPad, account writes or store submission.
Existing iOS PNG format retained; layered Icon Composer packaging remains a later native release enhancement.

icon.provenance: Original geometric paths authored for Vipi; no third-party artwork or font glyph.
icon.review: Viewed full-size exported PNG. Clean open V silhouette, two voices; no type, gradient, shadow or pre-rounded launcher mask.
